supportedAssets.note: Native XLM's Stellar Asset Contract, used as the demo asset since it already exists on testnet with no issuer setup required.

verifiedEndToEnd.note: Recorded against a prior shroud_pool deployment; superseded by the redeploy below, but the flow itself is unchanged and still applies.

redeployedForPauseFeature.reason: shroud_pool has no upgrade mechanism, so adding pause()/unpause() required a fresh deployment -- which cascaded to nullifier_registry and commitment_tree since their admin is the pool's contract address.
